name: Cube PoP
summary:
Cube PoP is a high-intensity arcade shooter built on speed, precision, and focus. You step into the arena with one goal: destroy as many cubes as possible and push your score to the absolute limit.

There’s no filler, no story, and no downtime. Just pure, skill-based action.

The Gameplay:

Pure Arcade Focus: Every second counts. Every shot matters. Your score is everything.
